metadata.Name: RuBERT
metadata.Description: RuBERT is a transformer-based language model pre-trained on a large corpus of Russian text. It is designed for various NLP tasks such as text classification, named entity recognition, and question answering.
metadata.Paper Title: RuBERT: A Russian Transformer-based Language Model
metadata.Abstract: We present RuBERT, a Russian language model based on the BERT architecture. RuBERT is pre-trained on a large corpus of Russian text and achieves state-of-the-art results on a variety of Russian NLP tasks. We provide a detailed description of the model architecture, training procedure, and evaluation results. We also release the pre-trained model and code for reproducibility.
